text: The Pilot Program for Climate Resilience (PPCR) in Papua New Guinea is a key initiative under the Climate Investment Funds (CIF) aimed at enhancing climate resilience in vulnerable countries. In PNG, the program is implemented through the Asian Development Bank's project 'Building Resilience to Climate Change in Papua New Guinea' (BRCC). The initiative focuses on mainstreaming climate resilience into national development planning, climate-proofing infrastructure, and enhancing food security and fisheries. It operates within a broader Pacific regional framework, collaborating with Samoa and Tonga to leverage regional cooperation and knowledge sharing.
